# StopwatchConfig

> **File:** `config/StopwatchConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

### Properties

- `presets` (readonly var): Durations as typed ("5m", "10m tea"), for StopwatchClock.parse
- `notify` (readonly bool)
